title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist sanctuary with a vermilion three-storey pagoda, nine-ring sorin, irimoya worship hall and suspended evening bell. A smoothly arched red bridge crosses the koi-and-lotus pond to a gravel court. Compact foundations follow the buildings and paths; branching maples frame the approach.
